interview.title: Initial interview
interview.subtitle: A few questions about your business so we can write in your voice.
interview.emptyIntro: Start with the services you offer. You can go back to earlier steps at any time.
interview.itemPlaceholder: Type an item and add it
interview.chipsHintRequired: Add at least one item to continue. Maximum 20.
interview.chipsHintOptional: Optional. Leave empty if none. Maximum 20.
interview.completedBody: Your answers are shown below and cannot be edited.

services.label: Services
services.question: What services do you offer?
services.helper: List the services customers can hire you for.

zone.label: Zone
zone.question: Where do you serve customers?
zone.helper: Describe your service area: cities, neighborhoods, or ZIP codes.
zone.placeholder: Austin, Texas and nearby ZIP codes

tone.label: Tone
tone.question: How should your business sound to customers?
tone.helper: Describe the voice you want: warm, direct, formal, or something else.

offers.label: Offers
offers.question: What offers or promotions should we mention?
offers.helper: List current offers, memberships, or guarantees we may include.

objections.label: Objections
objections.question: What objections do customers often raise?
objections.helper: List common doubts or comparisons you hear before someone hires you.

style.label: Style
style.question: How should we write?
style.helper: Sentence length, local details, phrases to use or avoid in the writing itself.

restrictions.label: Restrictions
restrictions.question: What must we never say or promise?
restrictions.helper: Words, claims, or topics to avoid. Leave empty if there are none.
